title: Mindanao governors pledge to cooperate on Dela Rosa manhunt
summary: The search for wanted Senator Ronald “Bato” Dela Rosa continues, with Mindanao governors and the Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao (BARMM) chief minister pledging their cooperation.
